'''Dar Zebbin''' was a male [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. During the [[Galactic War]], he and his partner [[Garak Los]] were working for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
